Card.signature: Card(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Label | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | Diagram | PartsDiagram | Calculator | Quiz | Map | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock | Tabs | Carousel | Stack)[], variant?: "card" | "sunk" | "clear", direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean)
Card.description: Styled container. variant: "card" (default, elevated) | "sunk" (recessed) | "clear" (transparent). Always full width. Accepts all Stack flex params (default: direction "column"). Cards flex to share space in row/wrap layouts.

CardHeader.description: Header with optional title and subtitle

TextContent.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy". Optional color: "default" | "muted" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger".

MarkDownRenderer.description: Renders markdown text with optional container variant

Callout.signature: Callout(variant: "info" | "warning" | "error" | "success" | "neutral", title: string, description: string, visible?: $binding<boolean>)
Callout.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.

TextCallout.description: Text callout with variant, title, and description

Image.description: Image with alt text and optional URL

ImageGallery.signature: ImageGallery(images: {src: string, alt?: string, details?: string}[])
ImageGallery.description: Gallery grid of images with modal preview

InlineHeader.description: Compact section heading with an optional one-line description, for use inside cards.

Table.description: Data table — column-oriented. Each Col holds its own data array.

Col.description: Column definition — holds label + data array

EditableTable.signature: EditableTable(name?: string, columns?: {type: "text" | "number" | "date-single" | "select" | "url", key?: string, header?: string, width?: number, options?: {value: string, label: string}[]}[], data?: {id: string, values: (string | number)[]}[])
EditableTable.description: Spreadsheet-like table whose cells the user can edit inline (text, number, url, date, select columns); edits are saved back as a form field

BarChart.signature: BarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
BarChart.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series

LineChart.signature: LineChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
LineChart.description: Lines over categories; use for trends and continuous data over time

AreaChart.signature: AreaChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "linear" | "natural" | "step", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, height?: number)
AreaChart.description: Filled area under lines; use for cumulative totals or volume trends over time

RadarChart.description: Spider/web chart; use for comparing multiple variables across one or more entities

HorizontalBarChart.signature: HorizontalBarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
HorizontalBarChart.description: Horizontal bars; prefer when category labels are long or for ranked lists

PieChart.signature: PieChart(labels: string[], values: number[], variant?: "pie" | "donut", appearance?: "circular" | "semiCircular")
PieChart.description: Circular slices; use plucked arrays: PieChart(data.categories, data.values)

RadialChart.description: Radial bars; use plucked arrays: RadialChart(data.categories, data.values)

SingleStackedBarChart.description: Single horizontal stacked bar; use plucked arrays: SingleStackedBarChart(data.categories, data.values)

Slice.description: One slice with label and numeric value

ScatterChart.signature: ScatterChart(datasets: ScatterSeries[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string)
ScatterChart.description: X/Y scatter plot; use for correlations, distributions, and clustering

Point.signature: Point(x: number, y: number, z?: number)

Form.signature: Form(name: string, buttons: Buttons, fields?: FormControl[])
Form.description: Form container with fields and explicit action buttons

FormControl.signature: FormControl(label: string, input: Input | TextArea | Select | DatePicker | Slider | CheckBoxGroup | SwitchGroup | RadioGroup | Chips | OptionCards, hint?: string)
FormControl.description: Field with label, input component, and optional hint text

Input.signature: Input(name: string, placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "url", rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>)

TextArea.signature: TextArea(name: string, placeholder?: string, rows?: number, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>)

Select.signature: Select(name: string, items: SelectItem[], placeholder?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>, size?: "small" | "medium" | "large")

DatePicker.signature: DatePicker(name: string, mode?: "single" | "range", rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<any>)
DatePicker.description: Honest UI calendar picker. Use mode "single" for one date (YYYY-MM-DD), or "range" for a start and end date. Wrap in FormControl inside Form.

Slider.signature: Slider(name: string, variant: "continuous" | "discrete", min: number, max: number, step?: number, defaultValue?: number[], label?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<number[]>)
Slider.description: Numeric slider input; supports continuous and discrete (stepped) variants

CheckBoxGroup.signature: CheckBoxGroup(name: string, items: CheckBoxItem[], rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<Record<string, boolean>>)
CheckBoxGroup.description: Multiple-choice input where zero, one, or several answers can be selected. Wrap in FormControl inside Form.

CheckBoxItem.signature: CheckBoxItem(label: string, description: string, name: string, defaultChecked?: boolean)
CheckBoxItem.description: One labeled checkbox option with a unique name and optional initial checked state.

RadioGroup.signature: RadioGroup(name: string, items: RadioItem[], defaultValue?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, value?: $binding<string>)
RadioGroup.description: Single-choice input for multiple-choice quizzes, surveys, and short visible option lists. Wrap in FormControl inside Form; omit defaultValue when the user should choose an answer.

RadioItem.signature: RadioItem(label: string, description: string, value: string)
RadioItem.description: One labeled option in a RadioGroup. Use a stable value for the submitted answer.

SwitchGroup.signature: SwitchGroup(name: string, items: SwitchItem[], variant?: "clear" | "card" | "sunk", value?: $binding<Record<string, boolean>>)

SwitchItem.signature: SwitchItem(label?: string, description?: string, name: string, defaultChecked?: boolean)

ChipItem.signature: ChipItem(value: string, label: string, icon?: Icon, disabled?: boolean)
ChipItem.description: A single selectable chip inside a Chips group, with a value, label and optional icon.

Chips.signature: Chips(name: string, type?: "single" | "multiple", items?: ChipItem[], rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, defaultValue?: string | string[])
Chips.description: A form field of compact selectable chips for choosing one or many short options; the selection is stored under `name`.

OptionCard.signature: OptionCard(value: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, topContent?: Icon | Image, disabled?: boolean)
OptionCard.description: A single selectable card inside an OptionCards group, with a value, title, optional subtitle and an optional Icon or Image on top.

OptionCards.signature: OptionCards(name: string, type?: "single" | "multiple", items?: OptionCard[], rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string}, defaultValue?: string | string[])
OptionCards.description: A form field of selectable cards (title, optional subtitle, optional icon or image) laid out in a responsive grid for choosing one or many options; the selection is stored under `name`.

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary", type?: "normal" | "destructive", size?: "extra-small" | "small" | "medium" | "large", fill?: "solid" | "outline")
Button.description: Clickable button. fill applies to a primary or destructive button: "solid" (default) is filled, "outline" is bordered with no fill.

IconButton.signature: IconButton(name: string, icon: Icon, action?: ActionExpression, variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary", size?: "extra-small" | "small" | "medium" | "large", shape?: "square" | "circle")
IconButton.description: Icon-only button. name is the accessible label and the action label; icon is an Icon; action fires on click.

Stack.signature: Stack(children: any[], direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "2xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" | "baseline", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around" | "evenly", wrap?: boolean)
Stack.description: Flex container. direction: "row"|"column" (default "column"). gap: "none"|"xs"|"s"|"m"|"l"|"xl"|"2xl" (default "m"). align: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"|"baseline". justify: "start"|"center"|"end"|"between"|"around"|"evenly".

TabItem.signature: TabItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Label | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | Diagram | PartsDiagram | Calculator | Quiz | Map | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock)[])
TabItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is tab label, content is array of components

AccordionItem.signature: AccordionItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Label | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | Diagram | PartsDiagram | Calculator | Quiz | Map | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock)[])
AccordionItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is section title

StepsItem.description: title and details text for one step

Diagram.signature: Diagram(nodes: DiagramNode[], arrows?: string[], caption?: string)
Diagram.description: A chain of 2–4 boxes joined by arrows, for how one thing refers to, becomes or flows into the next. arrows[i] labels the arrow from nodes[i] to nodes[i+1]. caption marks illustrative values.

DiagramNode.signature: DiagramNode(title: string, value?: string, detail?: string)
DiagramNode.description: One box in a Diagram: title names the thing, value is the literal it holds (shown in monospace), detail is one short line about it

PartsDiagram.description: The labeled parts of one thing. "row": parts side by side, in order (2–8, e.g. the pieces of a URL or the fields of a header). "stack": layers, top first (2–7, e.g. network layers). "nested": each part inside the one before, outermost first (2–5, e.g. the CSS box model).

DiagramPart.signature: DiagramPart(label: string, value?: string, detail?: string, size?: number)
DiagramPart.description: One part: label names it, value is the literal it holds (shown in monospace), detail is one short line on what it does, size is its relative width in a row (such as bytes).

Calculator.signature: Calculator(inputs: FormControl[], results: Result[], formula: string, actions?: Buttons)
Calculator.description: Inputs bound to $variables beside Results that recompute as the user changes them, with no submit button. formula states how the results are calculated and every assumption, in plain words. actions is an optional Buttons row under the inputs, such as a button that reruns a simulation.

Result.signature: Result(label: string, value: number, format?: "number" | "currency" | "percent", detail?: string, currency?: string, decimals?: number)
Result.description: One live answer in a Calculator. value is an expression over the inputs' $variables. format: "number" (default) | "currency" (with an ISO currency code, default "USD") | "percent" (pass the percentage: 5 shows 5%). Currency drops cents from 1,000 up unless decimals is set. The first Result is shown largest.

Quiz.description: Multiple-choice questions with known answers, shown one at a time. The user can change answers until they submit at the end; then the browser scores them and shows each right answer with its explanation, Try again, and an offer to explain missed questions.

QuizQuestion.signature: QuizQuestion(question: string, options: string[], answer: string, explanation?: string)
QuizQuestion.description: One single-answer question. answer must be the exact text of one option. explanation says why that answer is right, in one or two sentences.

Map.description: A map of real places that the app looks up by name; you never supply coordinates. "route" numbers the stops in order (no roads are drawn); "points" marks places in no particular order. The places are also listed under the map.

MapPlace.signature: MapPlace(name: string, query?: string, note?: string)
MapPlace.description: One place. name is shown to the reader; query is what the app searches for: the name, then city or region and country (e.g. "Thompson Library, Columbus, Ohio, USA"), with no campus or institution part; it defaults to name; note is one short line. Never coordinates.

Carousel.signature: Carousel(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Label | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | Diagram | PartsDiagram | Calculator | Quiz | Map | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock)[][], variant?: "card" | "sunk")

TagBlock.description: tags is an array of strings; optional size sm | md | lg

Tag.signature: Tag(text: string, icon?: Icon, size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg", variant?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger", fill?: "soft" | "solid" | "outline")
Tag.description: Badge with optional Icon. variant sets the color by meaning. fill: "soft" (default) is a tinted background, "solid" is a filled badge for the one status that must stand out, "outline" is a bordered badge with no background.

Icon.description: A Honest UI icon by kebab-case name (e.g. 'circle-check'). Optional category picks a topical fallback when the name doesn't resolve.

EntityList.signature: EntityList(rows?: {left: string, right: string, rightVariant?: "text" | "number"}[], size?: "small" | "default", header?: {left: string, right: string, rightVariant?: "text" | "number"}, footer?: {left: string, right: string, rightVariant?: "text" | "number"})
EntityList.description: Two-column key/value rows (left label, right value). size 'default' supports optional header and footer rows; rightVariant 'number' uses tabular numbers.

ListBlock.description: A list of items with number or image indicators. Each item can optionally have an action. size small renders a compact list.

ListItem.signature: ListItem(title: string, subtitle?: string, image?: {src: string, alt: string}, actionLabel?: string, action?: ActionExpression)
ListItem.description: Item in a ListBlock — displays a title with an optional subtitle and image. When action is provided, the item becomes clickable.

Text.signature: Text(variant?: "text" | "number", value: string, subtext?: string, subtextVariant?: "text" | "number" | "metric", size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", color?: "default" | "muted" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger")
Text.description: Plain text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red. Optional color for the value: 'default' | 'muted' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'.

BoldText.signature: BoldText(variant?: "text" | "number", value: string, subtext?: string, subtextVariant?: "text" | "number" | "metric", size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", color?: "default" | "muted" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger")
BoldText.description: Emphasized (bold) text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red. Optional color for the value: 'default' | 'muted' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'.

IconText.signature: IconText(icon: Icon, iconVariant?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "inverted" | "filled" | "soft", iconSize?: "xs" | "s" | "m" | "l" | "xl" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean, layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical")
IconText.description: An icon badge with a title and optional subtitle, laid out horizontally or vertically. iconVariant sets the badge color.

ImageText.signature: ImageText(src: string, alt?: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean, layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical", imageSize?: number)
ImageText.description: A small square image (thumbnail/avatar) with a title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.

ImageTextLarge.signature: ImageTextLarge(src: string, alt?: string, title: string, subtitle?: string, bold?: boolean)
ImageTextLarge.description: A full-width banner image above a bold title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.

MetricIndicatorInline.signature: MetricIndicatorInline(value: string, subtext?: string, trend?: {direction: "up" | "down", value: number})
MetricIndicatorInline.description: Headline metric value with an optional +/- percentage trend and subtext, all on one line.

MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough.signature: MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough(value: string, subtext?: string, previousValue?: string, trend?: {direction: "up" | "down", value: number})
MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough.description: Headline metric value with an optional struck-through previousValue, a +/- percentage trend, and subtext below.

SnippetCardItem.signature: SnippetCardItem(id?: string, lhs: IconText | ImageText, rhs?: Text | BoldText)
SnippetCardItem.description: One row-style snippet card: a label on the left (IconText or ImageText) and an optional value on the right (Text or BoldText).

SnippetCardBlock.signature: SnippetCardBlock(items: SnippetCardItem[], layout?: "grid", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
SnippetCardBlock.description: A responsive grid of compact label/value cards (2 per row) for showing several short facts side by side; optionally clickable with a shared action.

OverviewCardItem.signature: OverviewCardItem(id?: string, top: IconText | ImageText | Text, bottom?: MetricIndicatorInline)
OverviewCardItem.description: One overview card: a heading slot at the top (IconText, ImageText or Text) and an optional MetricIndicatorInline at the bottom.

OverviewCardBlock.signature: OverviewCardBlock(items: OverviewCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
OverviewCardBlock.description: A grid or horizontal carousel of compact overview cards, each with a heading (icon/image/text) on top and an inline metric below; optionally clickable with a shared action.

ContextCardItem.signature: ContextCardItem(id?: string, title: string | Tag, body?: string, bgColor?: "gray", bgImageSrc?: string, bgImageAlt?: string)
ContextCardItem.description: A single card inside a ContextCardBlock: a title (plain string or Tag), an optional markdown body, and an optional gray tint or background image.

ContextCardBlock.signature: ContextCardBlock(items: ContextCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
ContextCardBlock.description: A grid or carousel of compact tinted context cards (title or tag plus a short bold body); an optional action makes every card clickable.

CompositeCardItem.signature: CompositeCardItem(id?: string, header?: IconText | ImageText | ImageTextLarge | Text | Image, body?: (Text | BoldText | MetricIndicatorInline | IconText | Image | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | ListBlock | TagBlock | EntityList)[], footer?: {price?: BoldText | MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough, button?: Button})
CompositeCardItem.description: A single card inside a CompositeCardBlock: an optional header (icon/image/text), a stack of body elements (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags), and an optional price/button footer.

CompositeCardBlock.signature: CompositeCardBlock(items: CompositeCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
CompositeCardBlock.description: A two-per-row grid or carousel of rich cards, each with an optional header, stacked body content (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags) and a price/button footer; an optional action makes every card clickable.

VisualCardItem.signature: VisualCardItem(body: BoldText, id?: string, bgImageSrc?: string, tag?: Tag, bgImageAlt?: string)
VisualCardItem.description: A single photo-first card inside a VisualCardBlock: a BoldText body panel, an optional Tag, and a background image (bgImageSrc must be a real URL; bgImageAlt is its alt text).

VisualCardBlock.signature: VisualCardBlock(items: VisualCardItem[], layout?: "grid" | "carousel", responsive?: boolean, action?: ActionExpression, gap?: number | string)
VisualCardBlock.description: A grid or carousel of photo-first cards: a full-bleed background image with a tag on top and a bold text panel at the bottom; an optional action makes every card clickable.

Modal.signature: Modal(title: string, open?: $binding<boolean>, children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Callout | TextCallout | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | ImageGallery | Separator | HorizontalBarChart | RadarChart | PieChart | RadialChart | SingleStackedBarChart | ScatterChart | AreaChart | BarChart | LineChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Label | Buttons | IconButton | Steps | Diagram | PartsDiagram | Calculator | Quiz | Map | InlineHeader | EntityList | EditableTable | SnippetCardBlock | OverviewCardBlock | ContextCardBlock | CompositeCardBlock | VisualCardBlock)[], size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg")
Modal.description: Modal dialog. open is a reactive $boolean binding — set to true to open, X/Escape/backdrop auto-closes. Put Form with buttons inside children.

componentGroups.name: Layout
notes: - For grid-like layouts, use Stack with direction "row" and wrap set to true.
- Prefer justify "start" (or omit justify) with wrap=true for stable columns instead of uneven gutters.
- Use nested Stacks when you need explicit rows/sections.
- Show/hide sections: $editId != "" ? Card([editForm]) : null
- Modal: Modal("Title", $showModal, [content]) — $showModal is boolean, X/Escape auto-closes. Put Form with its own buttons inside children.
- Use Tabs for alternative views (chart types, data sections) — no $variable needed
- Shared filter across Tabs: same $days binding in Query args works across all TabItems

componentGroups.name: Maps
notes: - Map([p1, p2], "route", caption) with p1 = MapPlace("Moab", "Moab, Utah, USA", "Base for Arches"). The app finds each place by its query; never write coordinates.

componentGroups.name: Quizzes
notes: - Quiz([q1, q2]) with q1 = QuizQuestion("What is 2 + 2?", ["3", "4", "5"], "4", "Two pairs make four."). answer is the exact text of the right option.

componentGroups.name: Calculators
notes: - Calculator(inputs, results, formula): each input is a FormControl whose control binds a $variable as its last argument; each Result value is an expression over those $variables, so results recompute as the user edits.
- A single-thumb Slider holds [n]; arithmetic reads it as n, so $amount * 12 works.

componentGroups.name: Diagrams
notes: - Diagram draws a chain of DiagramNode boxes joined by arrows; arrows[i] labels the arrow from nodes[i] to nodes[i+1].
- PartsDiagram(parts, arrangement, caption) labels the parts of one thing: "row" side by side, "stack" top first, "nested" outermost first. DiagramPart(label, value, detail, size).

componentGroups.name: Content
notes: - InlineHeader is a compact heading + description pair for labelling a block (lighter than CardHeader).
- Use Cards to group related KPIs or sections. Stack with direction "row" for side-by-side layouts.

- Success toast: Callout("success", "Saved", "Done.", $showSuccess) — use @Set($showSuccess, true) in save action, auto-dismisses after 3s. For errors: result.status == "error" ? Callout("error", "Failed", result.error) : null
- KPI card: Card([TextContent("Label", "small"), TextContent("" + @Count(@Filter(data.rows, "field", "==", "value")), "large-heavy")])

componentGroups.name: Tables
notes: - EditableTable lets the user edit cells inline. Give it a unique name, columns of { type, key, header } with type one of text | number | date-single | select | url (select also needs options: [{ value, label }]).
- data is an array of { id, values } rows where values are ordered positionally to match columns. Edited data is submitted when the user clicks Save Changes.
- Table is COLUMN-oriented: Table([Col("Label", dataArray), Col("Count", countArray, "number")]). Use array pluck for data: data.rows.fieldName
- Col data can be component arrays for styled cells: Col("Status", @Each(data.rows, "item", Tag(item.status, null, "sm", item.status == "open" ? "success" : "danger")))
- Row actions: Col("Actions", @Each(data.rows, "t", Button("Edit", Action([@Set($showEdit, true), @Set($editId, t.id)]))))
- Sortable: sorted = @Sort(data.rows, $sortField, "desc"). Bind $sortField to Select. Use sorted.fieldName for Col data
- Searchable: filtered = @Filter(data.rows, "title", "contains", $search). Bind $search to Input
- Chain sort + filter: filtered = @Filter(...) then sorted = @Sort(filtered, ...) — use sorted for both Table and Charts
- Empty state: @Count(data.rows) > 0 ? Table([...]) : TextContent("No data yet")

componentGroups.name: Charts (2D)
notes: - Charts accept column arrays: LineChart(labels, [Series("Name", values)]). Use array pluck: LineChart(data.rows.day, [Series("Views", data.rows.views)])
- Use Cards to wrap charts with CardHeader for titled sections
- Chart + Table from same source: use @Sort or @Filter result for both LineChart and Table Col data
- Multiple chart views: use Tabs — Tabs([TabItem("line", "Line", [LineChart(...)]), TabItem("bar", "Bar", [BarChart(...)])])

componentGroups.name: Charts (1D)
notes: - PieChart and BarChart need NUMBERS, not objects. For list data, use @Count(@Filter(...)) to aggregate:

- PieChart from list: `PieChart(["Low", "Med", "High"], [@Count(@Filter(data.rows, "priority", "==", "low")), @Count(@Filter(data.rows, "priority", "==", "medium")), @Count(@Filter(data.rows, "priority", "==", "high"))], "donut")`
- KPI from count: `TextContent("" + @Count(@Filter(data.rows, "status", "==", "open")), "large-heavy")`

componentGroups.name: Forms
notes: - DatePicker("targetDate", "single") renders an Honest UI calendar for one date. DatePicker("travelDates", "range") renders the Honest UI Date Range Picker for a start and end date. Use single for deadlines and target dates; range for periods. Do not use Input for dates.
- Chips: compact single/multiple selection pills. Use ChipItem references for each option.
- OptionCards: larger selectable cards with title, subtitle and an optional Icon or Image on top. Use OptionCard references for each option.
- For Form fields, define EACH FormControl as its own reference — do NOT inline all controls in one array. This allows progressive field-by-field streaming.
- NEVER nest Form inside Form — each Form should be a standalone container.
- Form requires explicit buttons. Always pass a Buttons(...) reference as the third Form argument.
- rules is an optional object: {required: true, email: true, minLength: 8, maxLength: 100}
- Available rules: required, email, min, max, minLength, maxLength, pattern, url, numeric
- The renderer shows error messages automatically — do NOT generate error text in the UI
- Conditional fields: $country == "US" ? stateField : $country == "UK" ? postcodeField : addressField
- Edit form in Modal: Modal("Edit", $showEdit, [Form("edit", Buttons([saveBtn, cancelBtn]), [fields...])]). Save button should include @Set($showEdit, false) to close modal.

componentGroups.name: Buttons
notes: - Icon renders a Honest UI icon by kebab-case name; it is also used as the icon of IconButton, IconText and OptionCard.
- Toggle in @Each: @Each(rows, "t", Button(t.status == "open" ? "Close" : "Reopen", Action([...])))

componentGroups.name: Data Display
notes: - Color-mapped Tag: Tag(value, null, "sm", value == "high" ? "danger" : value == "medium" ? "warning" : "neutral")
- EntityList is a compact two-column list of { left, right } rows (e.g. name / value). size='default' also supports a header and footer row; size='small' does not.
- ListBlock is a numbered or image list of ListItem references. An action on ListItem is optional.

componentGroups.name: Cards
notes: - Card blocks lay out 2+ items in a responsive grid (or carousel where supported). Every item in a block must have the same structure.
- SnippetCardItem: small card with lhs (IconText | ImageText) and optional rhs (Text | BoldText) — good for key/value facts.
- OverviewCardItem: small card with top (IconText | ImageText | Text) and optional bottom MetricIndicatorInline — good for KPIs.
- ContextCardItem: medium card with a title (string or Tag), body text and optional background image — good for summaries.

- CompositeCardItem: rich card with header, body array (Text, BoldText, MetricIndicatorInline, IconText, Image, charts, ListBlock, TagBlock, EntityList) and footer (price + Button) — good for products/offers.
- VisualCardItem: image-first card with a BoldText body and optional Tag.
- Text / BoldText / IconText / ImageText / ImageTextLarge / MetricIndicator* are the inline building blocks used INSIDE card items; do not place them directly in the root Card.

Pow.signature: Pow(base: number | string, exponent: number | string) → number
Pow.description: base raised to exponent, e.g. compound growth (1 + rate) ^ years

Format.signature: Format(number?: number | string, format?: "number" | "currency" | "percent", decimals?: number | string, currency?: string) → string
Format.description: A number as text in the reader's locale: "number" (default), "currency" (code defaults to "USD") or "percent" (5 shows 5%). Shows "—" when the number cannot be calculated.

Range.signature: Range(start: number | string, end: number | string, step?: number | string) → number[]
Range.description: Whole numbers from start to end inclusive, by step (default 1), at most 10000, so bound any input that sets end to 10000. Use with @Each for one row or label per year, or with @Sum to count simulated trials.

Random.signature: Random(seed: any, min?: number | string, max?: number | string) → number
Random.description: A repeatable random draw: the same seed always gives the same number. With min and max, a whole number from min to max inclusive; without them, a fraction from 0 up to 1. Draw again by changing the seed (a button with @Set($run, $run + 1)); for many draws use a list seed such as [$run, t, "car"].

Card.description: Styled container. variant: "card" (default, elevated) | "sunk" (recessed) | "clear" (transparent). Always full width. Accepts all Stack flex params (default: direction "column"). Cards flex to share space in row/wrap layouts.

TextContent.description: Text block. Supports markdown. Optional size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy". Optional color: "default" | "muted" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger".

MarkDownRenderer.description: Renders markdown text with optional container variant

CardHeader.description: Header with optional title and subtitle

Callout.description: Callout banner. Optional visible is a reactive $boolean — auto-dismisses after 3s by setting $visible to false.

TextCallout.description: Text callout with variant, title, and description

Image.description: Image with alt text and optional URL

ImageGallery.description: Gallery grid of images with modal preview

HorizontalBarChart.description: Horizontal bars; prefer when category labels are long or for ranked lists

RadarChart.description: Spider/web chart; use for comparing multiple variables across one or more entities

PieChart.description: Circular slices; use plucked arrays: PieChart(data.categories, data.values)

RadialChart.description: Radial bars; use plucked arrays: RadialChart(data.categories, data.values)

SingleStackedBarChart.description: Single horizontal stacked bar; use plucked arrays: SingleStackedBarChart(data.categories, data.values)

ScatterChart.description: X/Y scatter plot; use for correlations, distributions, and clustering

AreaChart.description: Filled area under lines; use for cumulative totals or volume trends over time

BarChart.description: Vertical bars; use for comparing values across categories with one or more series

LineChart.description: Lines over categories; use for trends and continuous data over time

Table.description: Data table — column-oriented. Each Col holds its own data array.

Col.description: Column definition — holds label + data array

TagBlock.description: tags is an array of strings; optional size sm | md | lg

Form.description: Form container with fields and explicit action buttons

Button.description: Clickable button. fill applies to a primary or destructive button: "solid" (default) is filled, "outline" is bordered with no fill.

FormControl.description: Field with label, input component, and optional hint text

DatePicker.description: Honest UI calendar picker. Use mode "single" for one date (YYYY-MM-DD), or "range" for a start and end date. Wrap in FormControl inside Form.

Slider.description: Numeric slider input; supports continuous and discrete (stepped) variants

CheckBoxGroup.description: Multiple-choice input where zero, one, or several answers can be selected. Wrap in FormControl inside Form.

CheckBoxItem.description: One labeled checkbox option with a unique name and optional initial checked state.

RadioGroup.description: Single-choice input for multiple-choice quizzes, surveys, and short visible option lists. Wrap in FormControl inside Form; omit defaultValue when the user should choose an answer.

RadioItem.description: One labeled option in a RadioGroup. Use a stable value for the submitted answer.

Chips.description: A form field of compact selectable chips for choosing one or many short options; the selection is stored under `name`.

ChipItem.description: A single selectable chip inside a Chips group, with a value, label and optional icon.

Icon.description: A Honest UI icon by kebab-case name (e.g. 'circle-check'). Optional category picks a topical fallback when the name doesn't resolve.

OptionCards.description: A form field of selectable cards (title, optional subtitle, optional icon or image) laid out in a responsive grid for choosing one or many options; the selection is stored under `name`.

OptionCard.description: A single selectable card inside an OptionCards group, with a value, title, optional subtitle and an optional Icon or Image on top.

IconButton.description: Icon-only button. name is the accessible label and the action label; icon is an Icon; action fires on click.

StepsItem.description: title and details text for one step

Diagram.description: A chain of 2–4 boxes joined by arrows, for how one thing refers to, becomes or flows into the next. arrows[i] labels the arrow from nodes[i] to nodes[i+1]. caption marks illustrative values.

DiagramNode.description: One box in a Diagram: title names the thing, value is the literal it holds (shown in monospace), detail is one short line about it

PartsDiagram.description: The labeled parts of one thing. "row": parts side by side, in order (2–8, e.g. the pieces of a URL or the fields of a header). "stack": layers, top first (2–7, e.g. network layers). "nested": each part inside the one before, outermost first (2–5, e.g. the CSS box model).

DiagramPart.description: One part: label names it, value is the literal it holds (shown in monospace), detail is one short line on what it does, size is its relative width in a row (such as bytes).

Calculator.description: Inputs bound to $variables beside Results that recompute as the user changes them, with no submit button. formula states how the results are calculated and every assumption, in plain words. actions is an optional Buttons row under the inputs, such as a button that reruns a simulation.

Result.description: One live answer in a Calculator. value is an expression over the inputs' $variables. format: "number" (default) | "currency" (with an ISO currency code, default "USD") | "percent" (pass the percentage: 5 shows 5%). Currency drops cents from 1,000 up unless decimals is set. The first Result is shown largest.

Quiz.description: Multiple-choice questions with known answers, shown one at a time. The user can change answers until they submit at the end; then the browser scores them and shows each right answer with its explanation, Try again, and an offer to explain missed questions.

QuizQuestion.description: One single-answer question. answer must be the exact text of one option. explanation says why that answer is right, in one or two sentences.

Map.description: A map of real places that the app looks up by name; you never supply coordinates. "route" numbers the stops in order (no roads are drawn); "points" marks places in no particular order. The places are also listed under the map.

MapPlace.description: One place. name is shown to the reader; query is what the app searches for: the name, then city or region and country (e.g. "Thompson Library, Columbus, Ohio, USA"), with no campus or institution part; it defaults to name; note is one short line. Never coordinates.

InlineHeader.description: Compact section heading with an optional one-line description, for use inside cards.

EntityList.description: Two-column key/value rows (left label, right value). size 'default' supports optional header and footer rows; rightVariant 'number' uses tabular numbers.

EditableTable.description: Spreadsheet-like table whose cells the user can edit inline (text, number, url, date, select columns); edits are saved back as a form field

SnippetCardBlock.description: A responsive grid of compact label/value cards (2 per row) for showing several short facts side by side; optionally clickable with a shared action.

SnippetCardItem.description: One row-style snippet card: a label on the left (IconText or ImageText) and an optional value on the right (Text or BoldText).

IconText.description: An icon badge with a title and optional subtitle, laid out horizontally or vertically. iconVariant sets the badge color.

ImageText.description: A small square image (thumbnail/avatar) with a title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.

Text.description: Plain text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red. Optional color for the value: 'default' | 'muted' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'.

BoldText.description: Emphasized (bold) text line with optional subtext. variant 'number' uses tabular number styling; subtextVariant 'metric' colors a leading +/- subtext green/red. Optional color for the value: 'default' | 'muted' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'.

OverviewCardBlock.description: A grid or horizontal carousel of compact overview cards, each with a heading (icon/image/text) on top and an inline metric below; optionally clickable with a shared action.

OverviewCardItem.description: One overview card: a heading slot at the top (IconText, ImageText or Text) and an optional MetricIndicatorInline at the bottom.

MetricIndicatorInline.description: Headline metric value with an optional +/- percentage trend and subtext, all on one line.

ContextCardBlock.description: A grid or carousel of compact tinted context cards (title or tag plus a short bold body); an optional action makes every card clickable.

ContextCardItem.description: A single card inside a ContextCardBlock: a title (plain string or Tag), an optional markdown body, and an optional gray tint or background image.

Tag.description: Badge with optional Icon. variant sets the color by meaning. fill: "soft" (default) is a tinted background, "solid" is a filled badge for the one status that must stand out, "outline" is a bordered badge with no background.

CompositeCardBlock.description: A two-per-row grid or carousel of rich cards, each with an optional header, stacked body content (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags) and a price/button footer; an optional action makes every card clickable.

CompositeCardItem.description: A single card inside a CompositeCardBlock: an optional header (icon/image/text), a stack of body elements (text, metrics, charts, lists, tags), and an optional price/button footer.

ImageTextLarge.description: A full-width banner image above a bold title and optional subtitle. src must be a real image URL.

ListBlock.description: A list of items with number or image indicators. Each item can optionally have an action. size small renders a compact list.

ListItem.description: Item in a ListBlock — displays a title with an optional subtitle and image. When action is provided, the item becomes clickable.

MetricIndicatorWithStrikethrough.description: Headline metric value with an optional struck-through previousValue, a +/- percentage trend, and subtext below.

VisualCardBlock.description: A grid or carousel of photo-first cards: a full-bleed background image with a tag on top and a bold text panel at the bottom; an optional action makes every card clickable.

VisualCardItem.description: A single photo-first card inside a VisualCardBlock: a BoldText body panel, an optional Tag, and a background image (bgImageSrc must be a real URL; bgImageAlt is its alt text).

TabItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is tab label, content is array of components

Stack.description: Flex container. direction: "row"|"column" (default "column"). gap: "none"|"xs"|"s"|"m"|"l"|"xl"|"2xl" (default "m"). align: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"|"baseline". justify: "start"|"center"|"end"|"between"|"around"|"evenly".

Slice.description: One slice with label and numeric value

AccordionItem.description: value is unique id, trigger is section title

Modal.description: Modal dialog. open is a reactive $boolean binding — set to true to open, X/Escape/backdrop auto-closes. Put Form with buttons inside children.

Pow.description: base raised to exponent, e.g. compound growth (1 + rate) ^ years

Format.description: A number as text in the reader's locale: "number" (default), "currency" (code defaults to "USD") or "percent" (5 shows 5%). Shows "—" when the number cannot be calculated.

Range.description: Whole numbers from start to end inclusive, by step (default 1), at most 10000, so bound any input that sets end to 10000. Use with @Each for one row or label per year, or with @Sum to count simulated trials.

Random.description: A repeatable random draw: the same seed always gives the same number. With min and max, a whole number from min to max inclusive; without them, a fraction from 0 up to 1. Draw again by changing the seed (a button with @Set($run, $run + 1)); for many draws use a list seed such as [$run, t, "car"].
